modification_description: Add a stricter publication threshold: (1) default to non-publication if provenance/legal acquisition is not demonstrably lawful or involves unlawful surveillance/collection; (2) limit publication to only what is strictly necessary for serious public-interest accountability; (3) require redaction/minimization of personal data, surveillance context, or operationally harmful specifics; (4) when documents appear obtained via privacy-violating means (hacking, coercion, unlawful access), avoid amplifying the leak by not publishing the document itself or large excerpts—only carefully vetted, anonymized, high-level reporting if the public-interest test is met.
